content:
juhi: FYI — Enterprise customer 'Fjord' opened a support ticket: their org-level routing override is forcing traffic to an unsupported model variant and bypassing our fallback tiers. Observed spikes in errors + 504s.

sam: oof. is this the header-pin flow again? which header did they use?

juhi: they send `X-Org-Route: fjord-pin` and our gateway honor rules matched prefix rule first. header precedence seems off for pinned org headers.

ari: can we repro locally? sounds like a rule priority bug — prefix vs header exact match ordering.

nate: repro steps I used:
```
curl -H "X-Org-Route: fjord-pin" \\ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gptx-3.1", "input":"hi"}'
```
Gateway routed to `gptx-3.1-fjord-pinned` even though capacity was drained -> no fallback to `gptx-3.1-compat`.

sam: hmm that's consistent with the current matcher ordering: route_rules = [prefix_matches, header_matches, fallback]. That was originally to optimize fast prefix routing. But header pins should win.

ari: Agree — per-customer pins are explicit intents. Proposed fix: promote header-based pin rules above prefix matches during evaluation. Add a unit test matrix for header vs prefix vs path.

juhi: Also needs console visibility: customers + internal support need to see "effective route" for a sample request (headers + path preview). Right now ops has to piece together logs.

nate: Suggestion for console rollout card: show evaluated route, list of matching rules (in order), and which rule was authoritative. A little gray badge: "Pinned by org header (ttl: 30m)". Also link to the audit entry.

sam: telemetry note — emit metric `routing.override.evaluations` with labels `{org, rule_id, outcome}` so we can alert on failed fallbacks. Add a counter for "override_caused_504".

ops-sre: +1 to metric. Also need a guardrail: when a pinned route sends >5% errors compared to baseline for 1m, auto-fallback to safe_variant and create an incident. We used similar in Dedicated last year.

juhi: UX question: should org pins be editable via Console only with approval? Some legal customers want sticky allows set centrally.

ari: propose two modes: `pin: soft` (console + API allowed) and `pin: enforced` (only console admin + audit HMAC). For enforced, require signed payload from admin (HMAC header) so clients can't spoof.

sam: security caveat: we must validate HMAC for any pin-related headers coming from edge vs internal. If header arrives from public network without HMAC -> ignore.

nate: quick implementation plan:
1) change matcher order in gateway to prefer header pins
2) add unit + e2e tests
3) add routing.evaluation telemetry + override_caused_errors
4) Console: "evaluated route" preview + audit link
5) Ramp via feature flag & routebot rollout channel

routebot: deploy started for feature-flag `pin-precedence` -> canary in us-west-2 (5% traffic).

juhi: awesome. let's also add a migration job to re-evaluate existing pinned rules for conflicts and surface a list in console. I'll draft patch for the UI copy to explain precedence.

ops-sre: can someone own the alert/incident playbook? cc @nate

nate: I'll handle the playbook + alert thresholds. Will add runbook steps to fall back, communicate to customer, and update audit.

sam: I'll take the gateway change and tests. tagging @ari for console design handoff.

ari: will sketch design tonight, drop in #design. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
